title: ControlCatalogInstanceV1
description: LLP 0184 §Design/1's second identity: a snapshot of what a specific running target/instance permits, distinct from the build catalog. Bound to a startup nonce so a stale projection never asserts current permission — invocation admission is the authoritative check (§Design/1), this projection is advisory discovery only.

catalogDigest.description: Must match the build catalog's catalogDigest this instance was built from. A consumer refuses to combine a build catalog and instance projection whose digests differ (§Design/1).

startupNonce.description: The running process's startup nonce (LLP 0167). A projection fetched from a prior process incarnation is stale by construction.

enabledCapabilities.description: Operation identities this instance currently permits, per its own target/profile refusal rules. Advisory only; does not replace runtime admission (§Design/1).
